First impression, tempatnya besar dan kelihatan megah. Cuma kalau boleh jujur, ambience-nya kurang masuk di saya karena pencahayaannya terlalu gelap. Sebagai first timer, saya sempat bingung harus mulai pesan dari mana.

Hal yang paling jadi catatan buat saya adalah sistem pemesanannya. Walaupun sudah pakai QR dan web, tetap harus antre di depan kasir dulu baru disuruh scan. Menurut saya jadi kurang efisien karena ujung-ujungnya tetap menumpuk di kasir. Akan lebih enak kalau pelanggan bisa langsung duduk di meja, scan QR, lalu pesan dan bayar dari tempat duduk.

Website untuk pesan juga rasanya masih perlu dirapikan. Tampilannya agak membingungkan dan kurang nyaman dilihat, jadi saya sendiri malah malas scroll menu terlalu jauh dan akhirnya cuma pilih menu yang langsung kelihatan. Ditambah lagi pilihan metode pembayarannya juga belum lengkap, jadi proses checkout terasa lebih lama.

Setelah selesai bayar, kami juga tidak diberi nomor meja dengan jelas karena QR yang dipakai berasal dari kertas meja yang berbeda-beda. Jadi sempat bingung juga nanti pesanannya akan diantar ke mana.

Teman saya juga sempat dipanggil lewat pengeras suara sampai berkali-kali, padahal pelanggan lain tidak. Menurut saya itu agak kurang perlu dan malah bikin tidak nyaman.

Soal waktu tunggu, ini yang paling mengecewakan. Pesanan saya hampir satu jam baru datang. Sekitar 30 menit pertama saya sudah sempat ke kasir karena di website statusnya tertulis gagal, padahal saldo rekening saya sudah terpotong. Setelah dicek baru diproses. Setengah jam kemudian saya tanya lagi karena minuman masih belum datang. Rasanya kurang ada koordinasi.

Staf yang mengantar pesanan juga masih kurang bisa membantu. Beberapa kali ditanya soal pesanan, jawabannya hanya “kurang tahu”, jadi tetap harus balik lagi ke kasir untuk cari informasi. Menurut saya, koordinasi antartim masih bisa ditingkatkan supaya pelanggan tidak kebingungan.

Kalau boleh kasih masukan lagi, mungkin standar grooming karyawannya juga bisa lebih diperhatikan. Saya sempat melihat ada staf di area bar yang memakai sandal. Memang terdengar sepele, tapi dengan konsep tempat yang sebesar dan sebagus ini, penampilan staf juga ikut membentuk kesan profesional.

Untuk makanan dan minuman sebenarnya menurut saya masih oke. Cuma karena proses dari awal sudah cukup menguras waktu dan tenaga, pas makan jadi rasanya kurang bisa menikmati. Saya juga coba dimsumnya yang harganya sekitar Rp30.000. Isinya hanya empat buah dan menurut selera saya rasanya masih biasa saja, jadi value yang didapat terasa kurang.

Satu lagi, di informasi tertulis tutup pukul 00.00, tetapi sekitar pukul 23.00 sudah close order. Kalau memang jam operasional berubah, sebaiknya langsung diperbarui supaya pelanggan tidak salah ekspektasi.

Sayang sekali karena sebenarnya tempat ini punya potensi besar. Bangunannya bagus, luas, dan konsepnya juga menarik. Semoga ke depannya alur pemesanan, tampilan website, koordinasi staf, kecepatan pelayanan, dan standar operasionalnya bisa lebih diperbaiki. Setengah jam kemudian saya tanya lagi karena minuman masih belum datang. Rasanya kurang ada koordinasi.

Staf yang mengantar pesanan juga masih kurang bisa membantu. Beberapa kali ditanya soal pesanan, jawabannya hanya “kurang tahu”, jadi tetap harus balik lagi ke kasir untuk cari informasi. Menurut saya, koordinasi antartim masih bisa ditingkatkan supaya pelanggan tidak kebingungan.

Kalau boleh kasih masukan lagi, mungkin standar grooming karyawannya juga bisa lebih diperhatikan. Saya sempat melihat ada staf di area bar yang memakai sandal. Memang terdengar sepele, tapi dengan konsep tempat yang sebesar dan sebagus ini, penampilan staf juga ikut membentuk kesan profesional.

Untuk makanan dan minuman sebenarnya menurut saya masih oke. Cuma karena proses dari awal sudah cukup menguras waktu dan tenaga, pas makan jadi rasanya kurang bisa menikmati. Saya juga coba dimsumnya yang harganya sekitar Rp30.000. Isinya hanya empat buah dan menurut selera saya rasanya masih biasa saja, jadi value yang didapat terasa kurang.

Satu lagi, di informasi tertulis tutup pukul 00.00, tetapi sekitar pukul 23.00 sudah close order. Kalau memang jam operasional berubah, sebaiknya langsung diperbarui supaya pelanggan tidak salah ekspektasi.

At first impression, the place was large and looked grand. Honestly, the ambiance wasn't quite right for me because the lighting was too dark. As a first-timer, I was a little confused about where to start ordering.

The thing that really stood out to me was the ordering system. Even though they use QR codes and the web, you still have to queue at the cashier before being asked to scan your card. I think this is inefficient, as people end up piling up at the cashier. It would be nice if customers could just sit at a table, scan the QR code, then order and pay from their seats.

The ordering website also needs some improvement. The layout is a bit confusing and uncomfortable, so I didn't bother scrolling through the menu and ended up just choosing the one I saw right away. Furthermore, the payment options aren't comprehensive, making the checkout process feel longer.

After paying, we weren't given a clear table number because the QR codes used were made from different paper. So, I was a little confused about where our order would be delivered.

My friend was also called over the loudspeaker repeatedly, even though other customers weren't. I found it somewhat unnecessary and actually made things uncomfortable.

The wait time was the most disappointing part. My order took almost an hour to arrive. Within the first 30 minutes, I went to the cashier because the website said it had failed, even though my account balance had already been deducted. After checking, it was processed. Half an hour later, I asked again because my drink still hadn't arrived. There seemed to be a lack of coordination.

The staff delivering the order were also less than helpful. Several times I asked about the order, they simply said "I don't know," so I had to go back to the cashier to find out more. I think coordination between teams could be improved to avoid customer confusion.

If I may offer some feedback, perhaps more attention could be paid to employee grooming standards. I did notice some staff in the bar area wearing sandals. It may seem trivial, but with a place this large and well-designed, the staff's appearance contributes to a professional impression.

I actually thought the food and drinks were okay. However, because the process from the beginning was quite time-consuming and labor-intensive, I felt like I wasn't able to enjoy my meal. I also tried the dim sum, which cost around Rp 30,000. There were only four pieces, and in my opinion, the taste was mediocre, so the value felt lacking.

One more thing, the information says they close at 12:00 AM, but orders close around 11:00 PM. If the operating hours have changed, they should be updated immediately to avoid misplaced expectations.

It's a shame because this place has great potential. The building is beautiful, spacious, and the concept is interesting. Hopefully, the ordering process, website layout, staff coordination, service speed, and operational standards can be further improved in the future. It's tucked away in a small alley, but has ample parking.
My first time here, I tried the palm sugar milk coffee (Kopi Meira, if I'm not mistaken).
The coffee isn't bitter or sour; it seems like a blend of Robusta and Arabica.
The espresso isn't too strong, so if you can't stand coffee but still want it, you might want to try it here.
The palm sugar is a bit too sweet for me, so you have to drink it slowly to let the ice melt and tone down the sweetness.

A typical bite here never costs more than 50,000 Rupiah.
The coffee is delicious and affordable. My personal favorites are the Sweet Americano with lemon syrup and Kopi Grand. Simetris' signature fried cassava is also a popular choice for sharing. 10,000 Rupiah gets you a full paper bowl.
Their non-coffee beverages are also delicious, especially the matcha latte and chocolate.
Their service is excellent, always smiling and friendly to customers.
The downside might be the rather cramped indoor area.
There's only one long sofa and two sets of tables, which can accommodate two people. The maximum number of people allowed indoors is probably no more than 10-11.
But don't worry, they provide plenty of extra chairs.
Parking is quite convenient and spacious.

Nice atmosphere, both indoor and outdoor.
- Outdoor is beautiful, green, and shady. I think the atmosphere is quite nice.
- Indoor, the interior has a pretty comfortable tone. I like the spacious, minimalist, and somewhat old-fashioned feel. <3. The downside is perhaps the AC. The indoor atmosphere isn't cool enough, and perhaps the position of the AC needs to be reviewed because it seems a bit off.

Menu
It's pretty tasty and fits the price and menu. However, sometimes some dishes aren't ready.

Service
Hmm, sorry to say, I think the service needs to be improved. There are several things that make visiting there uncomfortable.
By chance, there were two menus we ordered yesterday.
1. Fried rice. We ordered it at the beginning, but after waiting an hour, it didn't arrive. When the cashier asked, they said they were out of stock and they didn't remember. What should I do?

2. Mie Rebus (boiled noodles). I thought this would be a simple and straightforward dish. It turned out I waited 30 minutes and still hadn't arrived. I reconfirmed that it was still being processed. I asked for a refund, but thankfully, I was granted one, but I was a bit disappointed.

Overall, if you're looking for a friendly atmosphere and affordable prices, this is the place for you. 😉

Oh, and there are charging stations at some of the tables, so you can charge your phone while you're at it.

It's cozy and homey. With the buzz of people talking and the music that gently fill the room, it's a perfect place to chill alone or with friends.

The filter coffee might just be the best one in town. The richness of the coffee rings in my head like a lover's voice calling out to me. It's been years since I've tried the first one, and one year since the second, it's always been in my mind. No filter coffee can compete with this one. Each one I tried was sour, giving an unpleasant taste into my tongue. But this one? It's perfect. It's dark and strong, the taste coats my tongue gently yet prominently. It's just simply lovely. I am not a person that holds memory very well, but I'll always remember how good the filter coffee tasted. Unfortunately they ran out of it today, but I still got the chance to try some other menus. I tried the Kopi Di Sini. It's creamy and sweet, it'd be perfect for those who wants to enjoy coffee, but unable to take in the bitterness.

Lastly, the red velvet cake was heavenly! It's not to sweet, dense yet moist, and the cream cheese was perfectly balanced! I was thinking how the baker didn't shave off browning sides of the cake, but little did I know, it only made it even better. The slight crunch of that browned part also gives a gentle salty taste to the bite. It was hard for me to finish because I didn't want it to end! Everything was, once again, simply lovely. My first time here was for a fast-breaking meal with a friend. It's tucked away in a small alley, a hidden gem, but it's easy to find thanks to the sign out front, right across from the Military District Command (Kodim).

The atmosphere is cool, calm, and quite quiet, making it very comfortable. We were the only ones there during the fast-breaking meal, but it didn't take long for quite a few people to arrive. It's perfect for deep conversations, meeting friends, or just relaxing. There are also quite a few photo spots.

As for the food, I think it's standard cafe fare, but the portions are quite generous, and the lime leaf rice is the best. I also got delicious fried bananas for breaking the fast, and I really tasted the palm sugar😍

What I really liked was the friendly service from the staff. Especially when I wanted to borrow a prayer robe from a female staff member, she was so kind. Keep it up, sis!

The night view here is also quite beautiful. I just have a few notes: the lighting is a bit dim and too yellow, so sometimes the results aren't optimal when taking photos. Maybe you could add a few more or make it brighter. 🥲

One more thing, there seems to be a lack of fans near the stairs, right under the lights. Sitting there feels a bit stuffy, so maybe you could add another fan to make it more comfortable, or maybe turn on the AC, hehe.

Oh yeah, unfortunately, there's no prayer room here yet. But since it was quiet at the time, we were able to use the empty spot in the customer area for prayer.
